description: This header file declares internal API function prototypes for the Slap Var Entity object within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane implementation, including functions for getting and setting variable syntax, content type, and usage type, along with a reset function.

methods.name: SlapVeoReset
methods.description: Resets the state of the Slap Var Entity object.

methods.name: SlapVeoGetVarSyntax
methods.description: Retrieves the syntax of the variable.

methods.name: SlapVeoGetVarContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the content type of the variable.

methods.name: SlapVeoSetVarContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type of the variable.

methods.name: SlapVeoGetVarUsageType
methods.description: Retrieves the usage type of the variable.

methods.name: SlapVeoSetVarUsageType
methods.description: Sets the usage type of the variable.
